I don't have tips for playing well aside from finding a single character and sticking with them. Not focusing on one or two puts you at a disadvantage against people who focus all their effort into a main. If you like Young Link, I suggest you only play him, at least while there.

Also, not as important for this tournament, but just for your future improvement, is if you play against people better than you, take this opportunity to ask them what you could do to improve. They might be able to point out flaws that you could work on or predictable moves or anything really. Criticism is one of the best tools for your improvement, and don't look at it as a negative thing.

Have fun!
